name: Schwangau (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Schwangau (a white swan on red).
history: Municipal flag of Schwangau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schwangau arms — white swan on red
